about_the_game:
DEVIL'S WAY:BOHEMIAN pushes the boundaries of dark humor!

Control the life and choices of the down-and-out main character, James DUD, and face the consequences.

In this dystopia where the fates of aimless men are determined by a malevolent AI, every choice you make can fundamentally alter the outcome.

So, is there violence or profanity in the game?

Plenty of it.

Is there plenty of dark humor with lots of references?

More than you could ever want.

So, does it have humor that will make you laugh until you cry?

If you know how to have fun in games, why not?

WARNING:

The references in this game are entirely fictional, based on a dystopian world. They are not inspired by any real people or events; everything is purely imaginary.

Finally, our game is intended for those who view games solely as games.

short_description: DEVIL'S WAY: BOHEMIAN is the sequel to the DEVIL'S WAY series, set in a sinister dystopia. It's back with various mini-games and longer playtime.
